name: pairing with an end that has a different number of tracks pairs none
covers: pairing: two ends pressed together pair; a third end in the window, or a track-count mismatch, pairs none; a window that expires leaves the link unchanged.
about: End A has two tracks and an empty link. Pair is pressed at scan 5 (0.5 s, until 30.5 s), and east/A announces one track at scan 6 (until 30.6 s). Two announcements that are not <board>/<end>/<tracks> are ignored, or they would crowd the window. At 30.6 s the group closes: one other end, with one track, so nothing is linked and the end logs tracks.
